## Description

Sell index options or straddles where implied volatility exceeds expected realized volatility, sometimes buying far-out-of-the-money protection.

## Where it may fit

Periods with a persistent implied-versus-realized volatility premium and manageable jump risk.

## Vehicles

Volatility-arbitrage, options-income and alternative-risk-premia funds.

## Required data

Option chain, implied volatility surface, Greeks, realized volatility, rates/dividends, margin, liquidity and tail-hedge costs.

## Caveats

Short convexity can incur rare, very large losses; backtests must model volatility jumps and exercise/assignment.
